searchText: Uh why is 0.11.0 so much slower? <@680234424037670912> is seeing similar results. Hmm I see it's from https://github.com/ethereum/lean-pq-bindings/pull/53 set gofast=true, make no mistakes... This was due to an upstream change, let me try and find it (we removed parallelism when signing iirc) Yep. How to handle parallelism is always tough. Making it single threaded might have been the right thing to do. Not sure. This IIUC https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/commit/0eea636c7 I guess if you sign multiple things at once, then you can do it in parallel and get the same throughput or if we can configure or something idk... - Starting from now the binding sources are in leanVM (see this [README](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/tree/main/bindings#readme)). The aggregation/verification is no no longer in-process, it sends requests to a sidecar that must be running alongside. - The VRF tree [PR](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/pull/805) is ready on leanVM (with bindings). I will wait for the spec to include the secret preimages to merge it. It comes with caching and pruning. That should solve your issue for the testnet <@412614104222531604> -> only generate 2^20 slots. the pr does not check the loaded bytes against the public key, so a wrong or stale file gives invalid signatures instead of a load error fixed <@412614104222531604> , Pari was mentioning some maybe annoyances that could arise if we have two processes running especially in the context of Docker and Kubernetes. Doesn't seem like a blocker, but something that maybe we want to look into/test?

excerpts.author: t.wambsgans
excerpts.content:
- Starting from now the binding sources are in leanVM (see this [README](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/tree/main/bindings#readme)). The aggregation/verification is no no longer in-process, it sends requests to a sidecar that must be running alongside.
- The VRF tree [PR](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/pull/805) is ready on leanVM (with bindings). I will wait for the spec to include the secret preimages to merge it. It comes with caching and pruning. That should solve your issue for the testnet <@412614104222531604>  -> only generate 2^20 slots.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: the pr does not check the loaded bytes against the public key, so a wrong or stale file gives invalid signatures instead of a load error
